title: Board Proximity Connect
description: Implement proximity connect: when dragging a node with no incident edges, overlapping another node's bounds shows a wire between nearest compatible handles (normal/detail/micro LOD only); release commits edge. Disabled in minimap and overview LOD.
summary: Proximity connect for unconnected single-node drag: overlapping node bounds picks nearest compatible handle pair, shows transient link wire (normal/detail/micro LOD), commits edge on release; skipped at minimap/overview. Pointer-down prefers link source over node drag. Fixed link-drop to LinkTargetNode (removed bad LOD gate). Tests updated for normal LOD handle hit and minimap (no node drag).
